died.name: James Hogg
died.cause: asking his wife to watch by his bedside during the night
died.last_words: It is likely you may never need to do it again.

died.name: William D. Hawkins
died.desc: United States Marine Corps officer and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Tarawa
died.last_words: Boys, I sure hate to leave you like this.

died.name: Robert Benchley
died.cause: words which he jotted beside the title of an essay which he was reading, "Am I Thinking?"

died.name: Quentin Crisp
died.last_words: You crawl out of your mother's womb, you crawl across open country under fire, and drop into your grave.

born.name: Voltaire
born.cause: when asked by a priest to renounce Satan before his death
born.last_words: Now is not the time for making new enemies.

born.name: Friedrich Schleiermacher
born.desc: German Reformed theologian, philosopher and biblical scholar
born.last_words: Now I can hold out here no longer. Lay me in a different posture.

born.name: Joseph Trumpeldor
born.cause: after being mortally wounded at the Battle of Tel Hai during the Battle of Tel Hai
born.last_words: "Never mind, it is good to die for our country." ("אין דבר, טוב למות בעד ארצנו")

born.name: Louis J. Sebille
born.desc: United States Air Force fighter pilot and Medal of Honor recipient
born.cause: when urged by one of his wingmen to head for an emergency landing strip after being wounded during the Battle of Pusan Perimeter in the Korean War. Sebille then deliberately crashed into a North Korean convoy
born.last_words: No, I'll never make it. I'm going back and get that bastard.

born.name: R. Budd Dwyer
born.cause: to the reporters who tried to stop him from shooting himself during a press conference
born.last_words: Don't, don't, don't, this will hurt someone!
